company.shortDescription: Hudl is a software platform that provides video analysis and coaching tools for sports teams.
company.description: Hudl is a platform and software that provides video analysis and coaching tools for sports teams. It enables coaches to upload footage of games, practices, and opponents, break the video down, add illustrations, voice clips, and text feedback, and deliver the video and coaching notes to their athletes.
